statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let J := fun (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ → ℝ) => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (v u:ℂ)*S n (high n) u*S n (high n) u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; let B :=  fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n : ℕ, J n (fun t => min (K n t) (1/2)) - U n (high n)/2 ≤ J n (K n)

plain_statement.zh: 以异常集上的能量控制削峰损失
plain_statement.en: Bound the signed clipping loss by localized energy

brief.zh: 差权 (K−1/2)₊ 只在异常集出现，最大为 1/2。先验证实部下界和区间可积性，再对平方模积分。
brief.en: The excess weight is supported where K>1/2 and bounded by 1/2. Establish integrability and dominate the signed loss by half the localized squared norm.
